title: Quantitative analysis of m6A RNA modification by LC-MS
protocol: Remove medium from cells and rinse with 1× PBS (e.g., 5 mL for 60 mm plates).
Add 350 μL of PureLink Lysis buffer to the plate.
Scrape the cell lysate thoroughly using a cell scraper.
Transfer the viscous liquid into a new 1.5 mL tube.
Homogenize the sample with a 23G syringe needle.
Repeat the suction-release step 5–10 times.
Add 350 μL of 70% ethanol to sample (Sample: 70% ethanol = 1:1) and vortex.
Transfer 700 μL of the sample into the PureLink Spin cartridge and centrifuge for 15 s at 12,000 × g at 25°C.
Discard the flow through.
Add 700 μL of PureLink Wash Buffer I and centrifuge for 15 s at 12,000 × g at 25°C.
Discard the flow through.
Add 500 μL of PureLink Wash Buffer II and centrifuge for 15 s at 12,000 × g at 25°C.
Discard the flow through.
Repeat the step twice.
Centrifuge the column for 2 min at 12,000 × g to ensure complete removal of the wash buffer.
Transfer the column to a new 1.5 mL tube.
Leave the column on the tube for 5 min to evaporate any residual ethanol from the wash buffer.
Add 50 μL nuclease-free water directly to the column matrix.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 12,000 × g at 25°C.
Spin down the samples.
Adjust the sample amount to contain 50 μg of total RNA in 100 μL nuclease-free water.
Heat the samples in a dry heat block at 65°C for 2 minutes.
Place the samples on ice immediately after heating.
Resuspend Oligo(dT) beads by vortexing for more than 30 seconds or tilting for 5 minutes.
Transfer beads to a new 1.5 mL tube.
Use 250 μg of beads for 50 μg total RNA.
Use 50 μL of NEB #S1419S bead suspension to get 250 μg beads.
Add 0.5 mL Oligo(dT) Binding Buffer to the beads and rinse by pipetting.
Place the tube on the magnetic rack until clear (incubate for 1 min).
Carefully remove the supernatant using a pipette.
Do not use aspirator to prevent loss of the beads.
Add 200 μL Oligo(dT) Binding Buffer to the beads and mix well.
Add 100 μL RNA solution to 200 μL Oligo(dT) bead suspension (RNA: Bead = 1:2).
Mix thoroughly by pipetting.
Incubate samples in Thermomixer for 5 min at 800 rpm, 25°C.
Place the tube on the magnetic rack until clear and remove supernatant.
Wash the mRNA-bead complex with 200 μL Oligo(dT) Wash Buffer by pipetting.
Incubate on the magnetic rack and remove supernatant.
Repeat washing steps 6d and 6e.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 10 s at 25°C to discard wash buffer completely.
Do not centrifuge beads at speeds higher than 200 × g.
Place tube in a metal rack and remove residual wash buffer.
Add 50 μL of Oligo(dT) Elution Buffer to the beads.
Mix well by pipetting.
Heat samples at 75°C for 2 min to elute mRNA from the beads.
Incubate the tube on the magnetic rack until the solution is clear.
Transfer the supernatant containing eluted mRNAs to a new 1.5 mL tube.
Freeze samples at -80°C if needed.
Repeat one more round of Oligo(dT) purification (steps 4–7).
Conduct RNA clean-up using Zymo RNA Clean & Concentrator kit.
Add 100 μL Zymo RNA Binding Buffer to 50 μL mRNA sample and mix.
Add 150 μL of 100% ethanol and mix thoroughly.
Transfer the sample to the Zymo Spin cartridge and centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 30 seconds at 25°C.
Discard the flow through.
Add 400 μL Zymo RNA Prep Buffer to the column and centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 30 seconds at 25°C.
Discard the flow through.
Add 700 μL Zymo RNA Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 30 seconds at 25°C.
Discard the flow through.
Add 400 μL Zymo RNA Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge for 2 minutes.
Transfer the column carefully into a new 1.5 mL tube.
Leave the column on the tube for 5 minutes to evaporate any residual ethanol from the wash buffer.
Add 15 μL nuclease-free water directly to the column matrix.
Incubate for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 16,000 × g for 30 seconds at 25°C.
Measure mRNA concentration using Nanodrop with absorbance at 260 nm.
Add components listed in the master mix table to each sample tube.
Vortex briefly and spin down the samples.
Incubate the samples in Thermomixer for 2 hours at 37°C with agitation at 800 rpm for 30 seconds every 5 minutes.
Add 2 μL of 2 M ammonium bicarbonate solution to the samples.
Vortex briefly and spin down the samples.
Add 1 unit of alkaline phosphatase to the samples.
Vortex briefly and spin down the samples.
Incubate the samples in Thermomixer for 2 hours at 37°C with agitation at 800 rpm for 30 seconds every 5 minutes.
Re-neutralize the solution by adding 1 μL of 1.2 M HCl.
Vortex briefly to mix the samples.
Centrifuge the samples for 30 min at 16,000 × g at 4°C.
Transfer 20 μL supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube.
Mix 20 μL of the purified nucleoside samples with 40 μL of acetonitrile.
Centrifuge the samples at 16,000 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Carefully transfer 40 μL of supernatant to a new LC-MS vial.
Inject 3 μL of samples into the LC-MS system with the setting parameters described above.
